result.summary: Found 1 issue: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a loading spinner on top of an image that has already loaded. The rest of the page is visually consistent. Partially visible carousel items and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport are expected behavior and are not reported.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner sits in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image in the 'Popular right now' section, even though the ramen image has fully rendered. The loading indicator appears stuck. It hides the image content and suggests the card is still loading or unresponsive.
issues.suggestion: Remove or hide the spinner once the image has loaded, for example in the image onLoad handler. Also handle the error and cached-image cases so the loading state is always cleared, and render the spinner only while the image is actually loading.
